notes_caveats: DRAFT, UNVALIDATED. EARLIEST-DISCLOSURE GAP NOW CLOSED (2026-08-22): all 29 MCK 10-Ks have been examined. notes_caveats: DRAFT, UNVALIDATED. SOURCE_TYPE CONFIRMED 2026-08-22 by retrieving accession 0000075677-16-000030 (pkg1231201510k.htm). The disclosure sits under the 'Customers' subsection of Item 1 Business -- NOT the Competition section, which begins immediately AFTER it; the earlier concern was a proximity artifact. It reads: 'Office Depot, Inc. is our largest customer in the Paper segment ... In 2015, our sales revenue to Office Depot represented 45% of our Paper segment sales revenue.' That is substantively a customer-concentration statement, so the closed-vocabulary value stands, though it is coarse: the text is in Item 1, not in the notes to the financial statements. LINEAGE NOT EXTENDED: the same filing says 'Office Depot became our largest customer when it acquired OfficeMax Incorporated late in 2013', and PKG's own earlier 10-Ks name OfficeMax rather than Office Depot. That is a merger, not a rename -- the same basis on which Caremark RX was rejected for MCK -- so 2016-02-26 stands. All 27 PKG 10-Ks were examined; none before 2016 names Office Depot.
